$comment: The single source of truth for components and screens. Components this project has (status: existing, read from the code in KICKSTART Step 2) or has agreed to build (status: planned, matching design/digital-product.md §M1.1). lint.mjs (rule unknown-component) rejects any component, variant or prop not listed here. Reuse, then extend, then create, and add a new entry only with the user's agreement (design.md §0.5). import = the React wrappers' folder, relative to the project root: app code imports it relatively ('../design-system/components/react') or through a path alias, and the lint checks every import path that ends in design-system/components; props = the props the lint accepts (native attributes the wrapper forwards included); html = the framework-agnostic markup API (components/components.css); doc = its ui-inventory doc. Do not edit `ignore` without the user's approval.

screens.$comment: One entry per web-app screen (ui-inventory/screens/<id>.md is generated from it, plus your notes). route = URL path or file; source = the files that render it, relative to the project root or the design-system folder; components = every inventory component on the screen with the variants and states it uses (states from digital-product.md §M1.2). lint rule ui-inventory checks all of it.

preview.name: Design board
preview.purpose: The design board, generated by design-build/board.mjs: every part of the system as a tile, with tokens, type, color, motion and the shipped components in every variant and state, for review (design.md §16 Phase 5).

ignore.$comment: Tags and props that are never design-system components: the app root (App), framework built-ins and generic HTML/ARIA attributes. Screens and pages are recognised from screens.*.source, so they need no entry here.
